question: Does an oversold bounce setup (3rd down day) triggered into a Monday produce better stop-based R than one into Tue-Fri? Indian studies show a positive Monday effect (reversed vs the US); mean-reversion/bounce trades should benefit most if the effect is real, but expect it to be weak/decayed post-sample.
plain: Tests whether Monday helps oversold bounce trades more, per Indian day-of-week studies showing a reversed (positive) Monday effect vs the US.
